text:
frank_acme: Hey team — ACME is seeing 500/503s from the hosted API for the past ~20m. Failures spike when they send long prompts (context ~12k tokens) and batch size 6-8. Example request id: req_2026_03_17_42. They attached a curl and stack snippet but keep getting sudden 503s mid-stream.
cory: Can you paste a request id and the model name/region? Any auth errors?

devon: Customer says model: redwood/gpt-3.5-xlarge-q4a (rolled yesterday), region: us-west-2. Request id above. No auth failures, just 500/503 gateway.

alice: I'm seeing a restart cascade on the upstream inference pod for that hostpool. Quick tail from the runner logs around the req id:

```
2026-03-17T17:05:33Z infer_runner[21432]: handling req req_2026_03_17_42
2026-03-17T17:05:34Z infer_runner[21432]: kv_cache: prefetch 12000 tokens
2026-03-17T17:05:35Z infer_runner[21432]: ATTENTION_KERNEL: ptx_assert failure
2026-03-17T17:05:35Z infer_runner[21432]: segfault (signal 11) at 0x7f9c1e2a
--- container restart ---
```

And kubernetes shows the container restarted 3x in ~10m.

emily: Noted — there was a config push 28m ago that swapped the hosted weight for that catalog entry to the new quant variant (q4a) to cut cost. Deploy message:

"deploy-bot: rollout redwood/gpt-3.5-xlarge-q4a to hosted-us-west-2 (rollout id r-2026-03-17-0052)"

ben: On the node, dmesg shows GPU OOM-ish trace then a kill:

```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 1234.568001] oom-kill: kill process 21432 (infer_runner) score 142 or sacrifice child
[ 1234.568100] Killed process 21432 (infer_runner) total-vm: 1234567kB, anon-rss: 987654kB
```

Also saw a small coredump with SIGSEGV in attention kernel (backtrace truncated).

gina: OK mitigation steps: 1) throttle ACME traffic to batch_size=2 and context cap 4k tokens, 2) route ACME to fallback non-quant model (gpt-3.5-xlarge-fp16) while we triage, 3) pin a bug label and notify model-onboarding. Who can rollback the q4a rollout?

alice: I'll rollback the rollout and add a safety gate limiting batch/context for the catalog entry. Hypothesis: quantized attention kernel mishandles large KV prefetch, memory accounting bug leads to overcommit -> driver drop -> segfault -> container exit.

deploy-bot: rollback started (r-2026-03-17-0052 -> r-2026-03-17-0052-rollback), requested by alice. CI shows canary abort, initiating full rollback.

devon: Customer asked for ETA — any idea how long to fully rollback and stabilize?

alice: Rolling back now. Should be finished in ~5m, then we'll warm up caches and monitor metrics for 15m. I'll post update.

ben: After throttling we saw reduced OOM signals on the node. If rollback doesn't fully stop crashes we should consider reverting the kernel optimization in that quant runtime or pinning the model to a different execution path.

frank_acme: Thanks, appreciate the fast response. We'll hold traffic and try a few smaller prompts.

alice: Rollback completed at 17:08:12 UTC. Post-rollback logs show no segfaults for the last 5m on that hostpool. Monitoring ingress errors: 503s dropped from 18% -> 1.2% post-rollback. :thumbsup:

devon: Passing update to ACME support thread and adding postmortem follow-up. Action items: model-onboard to reproduce locally with long-context + batch >=6, eng-runtime to add defensive OOM handling (limit kv prefetch on quant paths), release notes about not using q4a for >4k contexts for now.

frank_acme: Confirmed — errors gone on our end. We'll reopen if we see regressions. Thanks everyone.

cory: Filing incident ticket with logs + rollback id. Closing thread when postmortem done.

deploy-bot: rollout r-2026-03-17-0052-rollback completed (chan: hosted-us-west-2).
